outcome.technical: tests/test_stamp_verification.py only. New `_unjudged(key, why)` raises AssertionError('<key> not judged: <why>'); `_judged` calls it on all four refusal paths (declared_tests problem, _at_head problem, dependency_plan problem, record holds/lacks a second or fix run) instead of returning (None, {'record': ...}). A raise fails the enclosing STAGES block under its name via _harness.stage (tests/_harness.py:1173 and :1319 run every block under stage), however the case's check is worded. Docstring rewritten to say so and why. No caller read the `record` key (grep '"record"' over the file: only the four return sites). sr16 tightened to `code == M.E_CANNOT_PROVE and block.get('status') == 'could-not-prove'` - the kept real proof on sr16's fixture, run through `_red` in the probe, printed `REAL exit=3 status='could-not-prove'` (E_CANNOT_PROVE == 3, stamp-verification.py:619), and the judged one `exit=3 status='could-not-prove'`. Class sweep: grep -nE '!= *M\.E_PROVED|!= *"proved"|not +.*proved|!= *M\.E_CANNOT_PROVE|code_?[a-z0-9]* (!=|not in)' gave these negative-shaped checks: sr16 (judged) - tightened; swc2 line ~7029 (judged, `bad_code != M.E_PROVED` with a positive status conjunct) - tightened to `== M.E_CANNOT_PROVE` as well; sr207 (~1421), sr26 (~1728), sl6 (~7951) read `_red`/the CLI, a real run with no record to refuse - left; se2 (~5921) and the sm1 detail filter (~5869) read M.red_verdict directly - left; lines ~1910/~2155 are `if` guards in helpers, not checks - left; the rest are label prose. Gate: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_stamp_verification.py` exit 0, `1/1 files ok, 356 cases`. ruff check on the file exit 0; vermin -t=3.8- exit 0. Dependants: .github/sweep-costs.json - still correct, no block gains or loses a run, only an in-process raise on a path that is not taken; tests/test__filed_returns.py (_crlf_cases) and tools/affected.py (_scan, _worktrees) - those names untouched; tools/sweep-selftests.py, tools/verify.sh, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md name the file by path, which did not move - still correct.
